assertions.claim: Clear hard objects around, lay the person on the side face down, time the seizure on a watch.
assertions.cn_span: 把周围的硬东西挪开，让他侧躺、嘴朝下，看表记时间

assertions.claim: Don't hold them down, don't pry the jaw, don't put anything in the mouth — it only damages teeth and jaw.
assertions.cn_span: 别按住他、别掰嘴、别往嘴里塞东西，那只会弄伤牙齿和下颌

assertions.claim: Ambulance needed: seizure >5 min, immediate repeat, unresponsive or breathing poorly, in water, or first-ever seizure.
assertions.cn_span: 超过 5 分钟不停、停了很快又发作、发作后叫不醒或呼吸困难、在水里发作、这是头一次发作，都要叫救护车

assertions.claim: Give water only after the person is fully alert (CDC first-aid quotes preserved).
assertions.cn_span: Don't offer water or food until they are fully alert

assertions.claim: For strangers the same actions are a tier lower in benefit but impose no liability (Civil Code art. 184).
assertions.cn_span: 对陌生人做同样的动作收益档次低一些，但也不会让你担责
